name: @ai-games/playground
description: Vite playground: pick an asset from assets/, live WebGPU preview via @ai-games/core, Tweakpane panel auto-generated from the asset's zod Params (z.toJSONSchema walker), capsule validate() badge/violations, Save (POST /api/params) and Finalize (POST /api/finalize -> asset.lock.json with sha256 hashes). The Node-side API lives in plugins/api.ts as Vite dev-server middleware.
